raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The defenders met them at the treeline — nothing reached your bedroll.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Fintan came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The Paparazzo stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
(Something new is moving in the treeline. It was never an animal.)
🔥 Petra, at the fire: "The treeline's different now. We mark it, we tell everyone, we don't go alone."

💬 Petra pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Malik Khan. From Ashford." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🕯️ The treeline is still torn up from the raid when the System's light comes for them. Nobody is ready. The light doesn't wait.
Nobody met Big-Eyes — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.
Nobody met Lockpick — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.

🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Maya of Stonebridge with 2 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Maya of Stonebridge raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.

🌙 Night. The lingering Lockpick gorges at the treeline — 1,225 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
